column1: # langspec/commands.tsv — the command inventory of the built-in library (and the model for every command library).
#   name      the command's name as written in a query
#   library   the prefix of its library; empty = the built-in library
#   synopsis  the call forms, ' / '-separated: substr(a..b) / substr(n)
#   kind      the registry kind: scalar reducing context keyed assoc rendering both; function for an expression function (pipes expr)
#   typed     the signature(s), ';'-separated, 'in → out': text number int float bool quantity(D) instant duration period
#             list(T) record table node reference null value; the input is what the command receives on stdin: the topic after |
#             or the list of all topics after @|; 'T…' after → = several results, one thread each

#   onnull    the result on a null topic: null (the default, left out of the appendix), 'no thread' (an expander forks the thread into one per result and a null topic forks it into none), unchanged, or the value
#   en / ru   the one-line description, English and Russian
#   note_en / note_ru  coercions, pass-through, refusals and edges, one sentence each
#   anchor    the spec label of the section that discusses the command
#   issues    internal: behaviour that looks inconsistent, to be raised; not rendered
